items.headline: Abbott plans to report Q2 2026 earnings on July 16, 2026, before market open
Abbott announced a global licensing agreement with ALZpath for a pTau217 antibody to develop an Alzheimer’s blood test on Alinity ci-series systems
Abbott declared a quarterly dividend of $0.63 per share, payable August 17, 2026
Abbott received CE Mark for Libre Duo and Libre Duo 10 Day continuous glucose-ketone sensing systems
